description: This file defines the StructureShape class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a structure shape that manages member references and shape retrieval in API shape definitions.

classes.name: StructureShape
classes.description: Represents a structure shape and resolves member shape references within AWS API schemas.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StructureShape with a definition array and a shape map.

methods.name: getMembers
methods.description: Returns all members of the structure shape, generating them if necessary.

methods.name: hasMember
methods.description: Checks if a member with the specified name exists.

methods.name: getMember
methods.description: Retrieves a member shape by name, throwing an exception if not found.
